Hi all,
As a user of physlib downstream, I wanted to ask if you'd be interested in a PR that moves Physlib to the module system. This is a blocker for downstream users who are building libraries with the module system right now.

The changes in this PR will touch every file.

  1. Every import will become a public import
  2. every file will have an @[expose] section public at the top
  3. The top level file will be populated by the command lake exe mk_all --module

The currently blocked PR is this : https://github.com/Shreyas4991/Algolean/pull/19
https://github.com/Shreyas4991/Algolean/pull/37
CC : @Tanner Duve
huh we're already on the module system
Physlib#1034 is merged 3 days ago, maybe you guys need to update your dependency?
We are using your stable toolchain releases
The current v4.29.0 release doesn't include this PR I suppose
do you guys mind waiting til v4.30.0?
There's a v4.29.1 with core bug fixes.
If you update the toolchain to that now, then we can also update ours
v4.30.0 will come next month and it would be a bit late for us.
ok let me bump it tonight, I hope changes are minimal
they are minimal. There was a bounds check error in the compiler part of lean and they were fixed. I can't imagine that affects any proofs.

seems like doc-gen4 doesn't have a v4.29.1. is this a problem? can I have doc-gen4 on v4.29.0 and mathlib on v4.29.1?

cc @Joscha Mennicken (I hope you're the right person to ask from what I found)
This is a point that should also be brought up in other channels. Doc gen always seems to be upgraded as an afterthought. I wonder how mathlib gets by. They released v4.29.1
I'd expect libraries that work on v4.29.0 to work on v4.29.1 as well without changes. It should be fine to use the v4.29.0 versions everywhere and just set the lean-toolchain file to v4.29.1.

I'm not sure about CI and other automated processes that use the version number to do other things, those might break more easily. But the v4.29.1 release just includes the one bug fix and no other changes, so it's pretty much the same as v4.29.0.
Yeah but CI failures are important, especially when one uses the fro provided defaults
@Shreyas Srinivas now bumped to v4.29.1 in Physlib#1045
What was the fix for the doc gen4 issues? We are running into the same problem in the quantum circuits PR in Algolean
I think we just kept it tagged at v4.29.0 here.
I've pushed a v4.29.1 tag for doc-gen4, so hopefully if you rerun your CI, it should work.
